entries.title: A follow-up that asks a question ends with an answer on a card
entries.body: When a crewmate files follow-up work that turns out to be a question, the crewmate that takes it up now answers it on a card. Before, it also expected to open a pull request it had no way to open, and could report that as a problem.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the answer arrives on an ordinary card.
